nurse.text: Hello there, love, and welcome to the Derry~Londonderry Sanctuary! Sit down, take the weight off, and let me look at your team.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Rest here. There's tea, a custard cream, and a window with a view of the Walls. It's always the best seat in town.
All done. They're in fine fettle, and so are you. Go on, off with ye. The Walls aren't going to walk themselves.
The Ark is the machine by the stairs. It has a screen, a fan, and the patience of a saint.

else.text: No bother. Pop in any time. Even if it's just to get out of the rain. Which is a good reason.
